basic_info.description: Discover this beautifully remodeled 3-bedroom, 1-bath full-floor flat in a boutique 2-unit building, located in trendy Bernal Heights. This light-filled home boasts modern finishes while keeping its quintessential San Francisco charm, including bay windows, a decorative fireplace, and built-in cabinetry. The floor plan incorporates an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area with a sliding door that leads to an exclusive-use patio and garden space. Modern updates include a stunning new kitchen with quartz countertops, timeless subway tile backsplash, and a stainless steel appliance package with a gas range. The tiled bathroom offers the flexibility of a shower-over-tub layout. Additional upgrades include efficient central heating, new floors, and a convenient laundry room. With three bedrooms, there's ample space for guests and a home office. Private storage included. Make 3535 Mission Street your new home today!
